# Import fixtures

Source: generated by `test/fixtures/import/make.mjs` in this repository (procedural geometry
and a procedural stave texture; no third-party data).
Author: Hyprune contributors.
Licence: CC0-1.0.

- `barrel/`: glTF 2.0 barrel, centimetres, +Z up, about 12,500 triangles, 2048 x 1024 PNG.
- `crate/`: OBJ + MTL cube, 60 cm, +Y up, one diffuse colour.
